name: Parties
overview: Scripture acknowledges the joy and freedom of youth, encouraging rejoicing in one's days, but it also warns that God will bring judgment for how those days are lived, including in the ways of the heart and eyes (Ecclesiastes 11:9). The Bible calls believers to live honestly and decently, avoiding wild parties characterized by rioting, drunkenness, and wantonness (Romans 13:13). Instead of excess and indulgence, Christians are urged to be filled with the Spirit, which contrasts with being drunk on wine (Ephesians 5:18). Ultimately, the whole duty of man is to fear God and keep His commandments, providing the guiding principle for conduct in all areas, including social gatherings (Ecclesiastes 12:13).
